first_stage_source: frozen E1 original threshold matching E4-1 label generation
features: same17D state; CF called only after original MLP Keep on cache misses; no I/O-gain gate

families.ScoreCascade: p<fixed_tau OR (p>=fixed_tau AND p<secondary_tau), equivalent to p<max(fixed_tau,secondary_tau)

curve_comparison: Predeclare grids before evaluation; sweep same grid on validation and test independently; compare policies only at EXACT SAME integer total GT hits across all three families, never same threshold or same Recall lower bound
exact_point_choice: For each empirical hit count in three-way intersection, min mean SSD configuration per family; no interpolation; report all exact common points in Recall range [99,100], with secondary skip counts
interpretation: Matched test-curve configurations use test outcomes to establish empirical operating points. Descriptive same-Recall comparison on fixed previously observed queries, not unbiased held-out deployment selection. Separate validation-locked comparisons also saved; no model training/weights/feature changes using test.
timing: one graph/cache load per batch, warm full queries before every config; randomized serial configs; exact-matched chosen test configs repeated two additional times, three totals; 4 query threads; no cross-query state or mutable policy history
uncertainty: 2000 paired-query bootstrap draws on fixed matched configurations; does not rematch Recall per bootstrap or cover curve selection uncertainty
limitations: E4 pool previously observed; no fresh confirmatory test set
joint trajectories shift despite Keep-only support gate
submitted SSD requests not physical reads
two-stage original-score arm analytically equivalent to one-stage threshold; verify every threshold using final IDs and counts
